evidence.en: It is my understanding that the Brazilian Secret Police investigated the incident which occurred on November 4, 1957, at Fort Itaipu, in the vicinity of Santos, São Paulo, when two guards were struck by an intolerable heat wave while watching an unidentified flying object.
